description: The chart illustrates popularity values for three models (Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT) across two category groups, “Songs” and “Basketball,” with multiple bars per model indicating different accuracy/answer-type conditions. The category axis is horizontal and shows the two labeled groups (“Songs” followed by “Basketball”), while the value axis is vertical, labeled “Popularity,” using a linear scale with tick marks shown at approximately 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220. Within each category group, bars are arranged in clusters by model color (blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, yellow for ChatGPT), and each model appears with three adjacent bars distinguished by fill patterns corresponding to the legend: “Acc=0 & GT Ans” (dotted/mesh), “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” (diagonal hatch), and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (unfilled/solid). In the “Songs” group, the blue Llama3 bars are around ~100 (dotted), ~95 (hatched), and ~120 (solid), the red Qwen2 bars are around ~110 (dotted), ~120 (hatched), and ~140 (solid), and the yellow ChatGPT bars are around ~110 (dotted), ~115 (hatched), and ~140 (solid). In the “Basketball” group, the blue Llama3 bars are around ~175 (dotted), ~210 (hatched), and ~230 (solid), the red Qwen2 bars are around ~180 (dotted), ~240 (hatched), and ~250 (solid), and the yellow ChatGPT bars are around ~190 (dotted), ~235 (hatched), and ~210 (solid). The bars are not presented in an overall sorted order by height; instead they are grouped by category and model, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color and pattern encodings indicated in the legend.
